purpose: Full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval evaluation for BGE-M3 hybrid dense+sparse candidate generation plus dense+sparse+ColBERT reranking.

evaluator.method: Full-corpus dense+sparse candidate generation followed by FlagEmbedding BGEM3FlagModel.compute_score dense+sparse+ColBERT reranking.
evaluator.note: This is a full-corpus hybrid run, not the earlier dense-only MTEB baseline.

interpretation: BGE-M3 hybrid r50 is now the strongest completed full Arabic MIRACLRetrieval result in this repo, with main_score/ndcg_at_10 0.800791.
The hybrid run beats dense BGE-M3 by +0.015561 nDCG@10 on the same dataset revision, subset, split, and top-k metric.
It also beats E5 by +0.036231, Qwen3-Embedding-8B direct dense by +0.100626, and Arabic Triplet by +0.187721 nDCG@10.
This validates the practical pivot to BGE-M3 dense+sparse+multi-vector retrieval before model training.
The claim should remain scoped to this repo's full MIRACL Arabic harness until public same-task leaderboard or ArabicMTEB/Swan comparisons are reproduced.
next_experiment: Run BGE-M3 hybrid r100 on the same full Arabic MIRACL split. If the gain is stable, run a small dense/sparse/ColBERT weight ablation and use the best hybrid setup as the teacher for Arabic retrieval training-data construction.
